name: Panic In The Femur Breaker
source:
Panic In The Femur Breaker is a short visual novel based on both SCP 106 and the 'FY' OFF fangame series. You get to put Ruka in the femur breaker! WOW!

[From [url=https://fyniverse.itch.io/panic-in-the-femur-breaker]Itch.io[/url]]
